title: verify_delegation_token missing resource validation allows cross-resource token reuse
description:
In delegation_tokens.py, verify_delegation_token() does not take an expected_resource parameter and does not validate that the token's resource field matches what is being accessed.

Impact: A delegation token issued for group 'A' will successfully verify when presented to access group 'B', breaking resource isolation between groups.

File: python/src/lichen/crypto/delegation_tokens.py
Function: verify_delegation_token() (line 297)

Fix: Add expected_resource parameter and validate payload.resource == expected_resource before returning success.
